findings.reason: the block must be resolved in `imas_codex/remote/tools.py`, which already resolves ssh_host and nice level from facility config, and passed down as a parameter, rather than adding a facility dependency to the deliberately facility-free executor.
findings.text: §6 says "the executor reads it for every script", but the executor's own contract is that it performs no facility lookup (`run_python_script` docstring and the `run`/`run_script` primitives at lines 853 and 993: "Does NOT do facility lookup. For facility-aware execution, use ... tools.py"); teaching the executor to resolve `remote_environment` forks facility resolution into two layers

findings.reason: the plan should extend the existing `DOCUMENTS` relationship (or state why a distinct edge is needed) so `search_signals`/`search_docs` walk one linkage rather than two.
findings.text: §3 introduces a `DOCUMENTED_IN`/`DOCUMENTED_IN` edge from FacilitySignal to the handbook page, but the graph already owns signal↔documentation linkage: `WikiChunk.documents_signals` (`relationship_type: DOCUMENTS`, range FacilitySignal, facility.yaml:3803) beside `documents_nodes` (line 3796), and the plan cites neither; a second, differently-named edge for the same job means two owners for "which page documents this signal" and the MCP edge-walkers must special-case both

findings.reason: the interpreter-version and library-importability checks should be added to `check_all_tools`/`check_tool` (or a shared helper they call), not re-implemented as a new command.
findings.text: §6's `discover preflight <facility>` probe duplicates `check_all_tools(facility)`, which already runs per-facility tool checks with `min_version` floors and reports `missing_required`/`version_too_old`; the plan adds a parallel probe rather than extending the existing one, so the facility-tool truth now has two code paths

findings.reason: the section must account for the added CLI surface in its own text (retire/merge, or state why the preflight cannot be folded into the existing facility tool probe).
findings.text: §6 adds a `discover preflight <facility>` CLI command to a family the brief reports at cli_options 0, and names neither a command it retires or merges nor a reason none can be

findings.reason: the section must state that it extends `WikiPageStatus` (or use an existing value plus a separate `fronts_database` property) rather than assume a status value that the schema does not admit.
findings.text: §3 has the seven handbook pages "carry `status: dynamic`", but `WikiPageStatus` is a closed enum (`scanned | scored | ingested | skipped | failed`, common.yaml:197) referenced by the enum-typed `status` on `WikiPage` (facility.yaml:3582, `range: WikiPageStatus`); adding `dynamic` widens a shared enum — a public-definition surface — and the section does not acknowledge the enum extension, name a value it retires, or say why none can be

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §6 hides ordered setup commands, the resolved interpreter, a minimum-version floor and a per-data-system override behind one facility-level `remote_environment` block, and §2/§3/§4 extend existing scanners and pipelines rather than scattering new wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan adds a second signal↔document linkage beside the existing `DOCUMENTS` family, and a second facility probe beside `check_all_tools`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §6 adds the `discover preflight` CLI command and §3 adds a `dynamic` value to the closed `WikiPageStatus` enum without either section naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched and cites the EDAS scanner, the facility schema, the wiki pipeline and the `data_systems` keys, but proposes the `DOCUMENTED_IN` edge and the `discover preflight` probe without citing the existing signal-documentation relationship (`WikiChunk.documents_signals`, `imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:3803`) or the existing facility probe (`check_all_tools`, `imas_codex/remote/tools.py:471`) that already do the same jobs.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §6 routes the facility block through the low-level executor, which is deliberately facility-agnostic, instead of the facility-aware layer that already exists.
